title: Portability and reusability: every component works in another repo by config alone and ships with its runbook
text: Owner, 2026-10-11 18:37Z: 'PORTABILITY AND REUSABILITY.' Earlier the same day: 'keep that shit here, but portable from the get go.' Binding: no component depends on this repo's names; each has a RUN runbook a fresh reader can follow on another repo; the factory spec export (specs/exports) is the proof.
